note: The single authored source of the Phase 2 network. Everything here is synthetic demonstration data: not real carrier schedules, rates or commitments. A route's days and cost are the sum of its legs and belong to that route only; no mode has a built-in duration or price. The Japan economy sea route (91 days) is one route-specific record.
cost_basis: estimated freight for one standard consignment on that route (synthetic)
